tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Find how UGT gets a job done on the user's own computer with open-source software from GitHub, such as subtitles, CAD, video or web pages to Markdown. Search by what the user wants done or by a project's name, or omit the query to list the newest recipes. A recipe is a verified way to get one projec

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get how UGT runs one GitHub project, by owner/repo or its link: the recipes people have shared for it, each verified for one job. Call it whenever the user names a GitHub project they want to use. Every GitHub project works with UGT, so the result always says what to do next.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Get one recipe in full: what it takes and makes, what stays usable after a run, the settings it asks for, everything it can reach and why, where it was tested, and every file it runs. Use it to tell the user exactly what a recipe will do before they run it.

tools.name: read_recipe_file
tools.description: Read one of a recipe's files, such as compose.yaml, its Dockerfile or recipe.json, to see exactly what it runs. get_recipe lists its files.

tools.name: get_install
tools.description: Get the one line that installs UGT on the user's computer and connects it to their AI apps, UGT for Claude Desktop, and what each computer runs recipes in. Omit the computer to get every one.
